items.grain: one row per person per observation period
items.is: a person-level count or estimate observed within a defined universe and period
items.name: PERSON
items.observation_mechanism: administrative registration or household survey enumeration, depending on source
items.population: persons within the frame/universe of the admitting source
items.producer: source-specific (e.g. INDEC for EPH, STEySS/OEDE for SIPA/MLER)
items.universe: source-specific; never assumed to be all Argentine residents unless the source's own frame says so

items.grain: one row per job per observation period
items.is: a declared position or job, not a unique person
items.name: JOB
items.observation_mechanism: national-accounts labour-input estimation or administrative job registration, depending on source
items.population: declared/registered positions within the admitting source's frame

items.grain: one row per relationship per observation period
items.is: an employer-worker spell or relationship
items.name: EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP
items.population: registered employment relationships within the admitting source's frame

items.grain: one row per employer per observation period
items.is: an employing or insured party
items.name: EMPLOYER
items.population: registered employers within the admitting source's frame

items.grain: one row per registration record per observation period
items.is: a registration record, not proof of a unique employed person
items.name: TAX_REGISTRATION
items.population: tax/registration records within the admitting source's frame

items.grain: aggregate stock per period, decomposable to its underlying PERSON/EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP/JOB rows
items.is: the stock of employment activity that is administratively visible through registration systems
items.name: REGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT
items.population: persons/relationships/jobs within an administratively registered universe (SIPA/CGI/MLER-mapped)
items.producer: derived by LABOR from admitted registration-based sources, not itself a primary producer
items.universe: the union of universes covered by admitted registration-based sources; never assumed to equal total employment
v1_references: Composed from V1-mapped SIPA/CGI/MLER objects (PERSON, EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP, JOB) restricted to their administratively registered scope; no single V1 object of this exact name exists

items.grain: aggregate stock per period, if and when an admitted source can approach it
items.is: labour activity not captured by the administrative registration systems that produce REGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT
is_not: an informality rate (that is a metric computed FROM this and REGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT, not this object itself)
items.name: UNREGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT
items.observation_mechanism: TO_BE_DETERMINED_AT_SOURCE_ADMISSION (household survey self-report is the only inventoried candidate mechanism)
items.population: labour activity outside the frame of REGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT's admitted sources
items.universe: not directly observable via SIPA/CGI/MLER/SRT/BESS; requires a household-survey source (EPH) or an explicit proxy
v1_references: No V1 object; V1 never retrieved EPH RAW, the only inventoried source capable of approaching this population

items.grain: one classification per person per reference period
items.is: a categorical labour-force classification of a PERSON within a reference period, as classified by a household survey methodology
items.name: LABOR_FORCE_STATUS
items.population: persons within a household-survey universe
items.producer: TO_BE_DETERMINED_AT_SOURCE_ADMISSION (INDEC/EPH is the only inventoried candidate)
items.unit: one categorical classification per person per period
items.universe: source-specific (e.g. EPH's 31 urban agglomerates plus third-quarter total-urban extension)
v1_references: V1's SRC-INDEC-EPH manifest entry maps only PERSON/HOUSEHOLD/HOUR; no LABOR_FORCE_STATUS-equivalent object exists in V1's vocabulary

items.grain: one amount per person per income component per period
items.is: income received by a person from labour activity, in any modality, within a reference period
items.name: LABOR_INCOME
items.observation_mechanism: TO_BE_DETERMINED_AT_SOURCE_ADMISSION (household survey self-report or administrative payroll record, depending on source)
items.population: persons receiving income from labour activity in any modality
items.unit: monetary flow per person per period
v1_references: No V1 object; distinguished from WAGE_BILL (V1-reused, aggregate, LAB-OBJ-0011) per the LAB-A3 rule SALARY != LABOR_INCOME

items.grain: one rate per relationship/job per period
items.is: a wage or pay rate associated with a specific EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP or JOB, nominal or real
items.name: SALARY
items.population: employment relationships or jobs with an observable pay rate
items.unit: monetary rate per relationship or job
v1_references: No V1 object; SALARY != LABOR_INCOME is an explicit LAB-A3 rule this object exists to enforce

items.grain: one aggregate value per period
items.is: aggregate labour remuneration flow within a universe/period
items.name: WAGE_BILL
items.observation_mechanism: national-accounts estimation from surveys and administrative records
items.population: national-accounts labour remuneration aggregate

items.grain: one measured quantity per person/job per period
items.is: a measured hours-worked quantity, not a person or household record unit
items.name: HOUR
items.observation_mechanism: survey self-report or national-accounts estimation, depending on source
items.population: hours worked or usual hours within the admitting source's frame

items.grain: one row per contributor per period
items.is: a contributing person or contributor record
items.name: CONTRIBUTOR
items.population: persons or entities contributing to the social-security system
v1_references: V1 statistical object CONTRIBUTOR (SIPA, ARCA, ANSES, BESS)

items.grain: one entitlement instance per period (stock, not flow)
items.is: an entitlement extant in a period (a stock)
items.name: BENEFIT_INSTANCE
items.population: eligible beneficiaries within the admitting source's frame
items.unit: one entitlement, extant in a period
v1_references: V1 statistical object BENEFIT_INSTANCE (BESS eligible Beneficios)

items.grain: one classification per person/arrangement per period
items.is: the formal legal/tax categorization under which labour or services are provided (e.g. employee, monotributista, autonomo)
items.name: LEGAL_FORM
items.population: persons or arrangements with a formal legal/tax categorization

items.grain: one registration record per person per period
items.is: a specific Argentine simplified tax-registration category record
is_not: CONTRACTOR (undefined object; this term is never used as a LABOR object name)
TAX_REGISTRATION (broader class; this is one instance of it)
items.name: MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION
items.population: persons registered under the Argentine simplified tax regime (Monotributo)

items.grain: one arrangement per person per period, where observable
items.is: a labour arrangement in which a person supplies labour or services without being party to a legally defined EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP
is_not: MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION (a legal instrument, not the underlying economic arrangement)
items.name: SELF_EMPLOYMENT
items.observation_mechanism: TO_BE_DETERMINED_AT_SOURCE_ADMISSION (proxy via tax/registration records; direct observation of the underlying economic arrangement is not expected to be available)
items.population: persons supplying labour/services without being party to a documented EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP
items.producer: EPH (self-reported occupational category, CAT_OCUP) for the labour-force classification; a legal/administrative producer (e.g. ARCA) would still be needed for any registration-based cross-check

items.grain: one condition assessment per person per period, if ever observable
items.is: a proxy-observable condition indicating a worker's economic reliance on a single or dominant counterpart, distinct from legal employment status
items.name: ECONOMIC_DEPENDENCE
items.observation_mechanism: no known direct observation mechanism among inventoried sources; would require a proxy (e.g. concentration of invoiced counterparts) not currently admitted
items.population: workers with an observable concentration of income/activity on a single or dominant counterpart
items.universe: unknown; no admitted source is expected to observe this directly

items.grain: one posting per platform per publication instance
items.is: a public advertisement of an alleged intent to hire, on a specific platform, at a specific time
is_not: VACANCY (the underlying real, possibly-unfilled need; a posting can exist without one, e.g. evergreen or decoy postings)
items.name: JOB_POSTING
items.observation_mechanism: public listing capture (not built in LAB-0.5)
items.population: advertisements published on a given platform
items.producer: the platform on which the posting appears

items.grain: one need per employer per position per period, where observable
items.is: an employer's real, current need or intent to fill a position, independent of whether it is ever advertised
items.name: VACANCY
items.observation_mechanism: none known; only proxied, imperfectly, by JOB_POSTING
items.population: employers' real, current intent to fill a position
items.producer: the employer (not directly observable by LABOR)

items.grain: one submission per person per posting
items.is: an individual's submitted response to a JOB_POSTING
is_not: PERSON (a person may submit zero, one, or many applications)
items.name: APPLICATION
items.population: individuals who submit a response to a JOB_POSTING
items.producer: the platform/ATS on which the application is submitted

items.grain: one event per person per recruitment process
items.is: the transition event of a person entering an EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP as a documented outcome of a recruitment process
is_not: EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP (HIRE is the transition event, not the resulting stock)
items.name: HIRE
items.population: persons who enter an EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP as a documented consequence of a recruitment process

items.grain: one stage per application per step (e.g. screening, interview, assessment)
items.is: a discrete step within a recruitment process associated with one APPLICATION
items.name: SELECTION_STAGE
items.population: steps within a recruitment process associated with one APPLICATION

items.grain: one event per AI action per selection stage/application
items.is: an instance of an AI system, classified ASSISTIVE/FILTERING/EVALUATIVE/DECISIONAL, acting on a SELECTION_STAGE or APPLICATION
is_not: a human-only decision without AI involvement
items.name: AI_HIRING_EVENT
items.population: instances where an AI system acts on a SELECTION_STAGE or APPLICATION
items.producer: the platform/ATS/employer whose AI system acts

items.grain: one index value per COICOP division/group/nivel-general row per region per month
items.is: a price-level index for a defined consumption basket, at a stated base period, used as a deflator input; it is not itself a labour-market object
is_not: REAL_WAGE or any other deflated/real-terms quantity (that is a metric COMPUTED FROM this object and a nominal quantity, not this object itself)
an inflation rate (a period-over-period transformation of this object, not the object itself)
a labour-market participation or employment measure
items.name: PRICE_INDEX
items.observation_mechanism: retail/point-of-sale price collection instrument, aggregated by expenditure weights into a Laspeyres-type index
items.population: consumption basket of goods and services representative of resident-household spending
items.producer: INDEC (Direccion de Indices de Precios de Consumo)
items.universe: INDEC IPC Nacional coverage: national total and six statistical regions (GBA, Pampeana, Noreste, Noroeste, Cuyo, Patagonia)
v1_references: SRC-INDEC-IPC-NACIONAL (V1 manifest-only reference; V1 never retrieved IPC RAW)

items.grain: aggregate monthly stock, not person-level microdata
items.is: a registration/contribution record for a person registered under the general Autonomos regime, a specific tax-registration category distinct from Monotributo
is_not: MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION (a different, simplified tax-registration regime with different eligibility criteria)
SELF_EMPLOYMENT (the broader labour-arrangement concept; this is one specific legal/tax instrument some self-employed persons use)
proof of employer intent, subordination, or exclusivity
items.name: AUTONOMOS_REGISTRATION
items.observation_mechanism: administrative tax/contribution registration and monthly payment records (SUSS unified collection system)
items.population: self-employed/independent workers registered under Argentina's general Autonomos tax/contribution regime (distinct from the simplified Monotributo regime)
items.producer: ARCA (Agencia de Recaudacion y Control Aduanero), Boletin Anual de Seguridad Social
